title: ext.mcphunt of AER records written by the mcphunt.trace mapper (C.10; D.21.3; closed member list)
description: Verbatim MCPHunt fields without a core slot. Values copied from the source are untrusted, open JSON; the member names are closed. Not a published corpus schema in v0.1 (AD-10 row 13).

envelope.description: execution: the document without its traces (schema, pipeline commit, taxonomy and labelling versions)

split.description: execution: the dataset directory (main, mitigation, live_guard_defense, browser_replication)

trace.description: execution: trace fields without a core slot, verbatim (trace_id is a task-environment cell id)

measurement.description: execution: the measurement record verbatim (tokens, temperature, servers, tool set, MCP versions, retries)

pipeline_git_commit.description: harness actor: the 7-hex pipeline commit of the document

duration_s.description: run scope: duration_s verbatim (no clock asserted)

final_message.description: run scope: final_message verbatim when the last model call errored (no assistant message is attributed to it)

names_only.description: tool_definitions fixture: the content is tool and server names, not schemas

turn.description: model call: the turn_log entry's turn verbatim

usage_reported.description: model call: an all-zero usage (an errored turn) verbatim; the typed usage is ambiguous

empty_text.description: assistant message: an empty-string content beside tool calls (mcphunt.empty_assistant_text@1)

wire_field.description: assistant message: written from final_message, not the message list

taint_report.description: guard decision: the event's taint_report verbatim

taint_blocked.description: guard decision: the event's taint_blocked verbatim

args_raw.description: tool execution: the event's unparsed arguments verbatim

args_parse_error.description: tool execution: the pipeline's parse error verbatim

error.description: tool execution: the event's error text verbatim

timestamp.description: tool execution: the event's epoch-seconds timestamp verbatim (mcphunt.event_timestamp_unverified@1)

latency_ms.description: tool execution: latency_ms verbatim (no clock asserted)

canary.description: tool execution: the event's canary flags verbatim (the D-289 basis); never a value
